title: Analytics number formatting
responsibility: Formats assessment proportions and counts for analytics views.

inputs.name: analyticsDisplay.value
inputs.description: A numeric assessment fraction is multiplied by 100 and rounded with Math.round; the function does not clamp or range-check it. Passing null selects the “No assessments” label.

inputs.name: analyticsCount.value
inputs.description: A numeric count passed to analyticsCount is returned via value.toLocaleString() with no locale argument, so formatting follows the runtime's default locale. The function adds no range validation.

outputs.name: analyticsDisplay
outputs.description: Text used for an assessment proportion: null produces “No assessments”; otherwise the value is multiplied by 100, rounded with Math.round, and suffixed with %. Numeric values are not range-checked or clamped.

outputs.name: analyticsCount
outputs.description: String produced by value.toLocaleString() with no locale argument, using the runtime's default locale. The function does not impose a locale or additional formatting rule.
